peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the state of the art status?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The state of the art (SOTA or SotA, sometimes cutting edge, leading edge, or bleeding edge) refers to the highest level of general development, as of a device, technique, or scientific field achieved at a particular time.
peopleAlsoAsk.title: State of the art - Wikipedia

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the state of the art approach?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: State-of-the-art methods refer to advanced techniques that demonstrate the highest performance on specific problems, such as less constrained periocular recognition, and are validated through their effectiveness across multiple datasets in recent years.
